scenes.heading: Virtual Hosts
scenes.narration: Dispatcher. Virtual Hosts. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What does the /virtualhosts property list for a farm?
scenes.heading: The /virtualhosts property lists every hostname and URI combination the farm accepts
scenes.body: Section 3 says /virtualhosts lists every hostname and URI combination that Dispatcher accepts for the farm.

scenes.question: What is the effect of using a single asterisk in /virtualhosts?
scenes.heading: A single asterisk handles all requests
scenes.body: Section 3 states that a single asterisk handles all requests.
scenes.narration: What is the effect of using a single asterisk in /virtualhosts? A single asterisk handles all requests. Section 3 states that a single asterisk handles all requests.

scenes.question: When a request arrives, in what overall order does Dispatcher evaluate farms and virtual host entries?
scenes.heading: Dispatcher evaluates farms from the bottom up, and within a farm it checks virtual host entries from top to bottom
scenes.body: Section 3 says Dispatcher starts at the lowest farm and works upward, and within each farm it starts at the top value and works down.

scenes.question: Which matching rule has first priority when Dispatcher chooses a virtual host?
scenes.heading: The first priority is the first virtual host that matches the host, the scheme, and the URI
scenes.body: Section 3 says the first virtual host that matches the host, the scheme, and the URI is used.

scenes.question: If no virtual host matches both scheme and URI, what fallback does Dispatcher use next?
scenes.heading: It uses the first virtual host that matches the host
scenes.body: Section 3 says that if none match both scheme and URI, the first virtual host that matches the host is used.

scenes.question: If no host matches at all, what does Dispatcher use?
scenes.heading: Dispatcher uses the topmost virtual host of the topmost farm

scenes.question: Why should the default virtual host be placed at the top of the virtualhosts property in the topmost farm?
scenes.heading: The default virtual host should be there because the final fallback uses the topmost virtual host of the topmost farm
scenes.body: Section 3 explicitly says to put the default virtual host at the top of the virtualhosts property in the topmost farm because of the fallback behavior.
